name: Sex Adventures - The Pool Party
source:
It’s not easy to find an open minded partner these days, but David and Angel hit the jackpot when they found each other. Angel brags about her bisexuality constantly, while David swears he doesn’t have a drop of jealousy in his body, and doesn’t have a problem sharing her. All bark until now…since neither one of them had the chance to prove there’s more to them than empty words.
Young and hot, the couple decided to settle this once and for all, and test the limits of their new relationship by going to this pool party David knew about.
Hosted by a rich lady named Winter, the sex party will offer them the perfect opportunity to meet new people and unleash their deepest desires.

Will their relationship survive Lady Winter’s special night of debauchery?
Follow their story and find out…

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2104600/Sex_Adventures__The_Pool_Party/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
现在要找到一个思想开放的伴侣并不容易，但大卫和安吉尔找到彼此后就中了大奖。安吉尔不断地吹嘘自己的双性恋，而大卫发誓他的身体里没有一丝嫉妒，并且在分享她时没有任何问题。直到现在大家都在咆哮……因为他们都没有机会证明他们除了空话之外还有更多的东西。
年轻又性感，这对夫妇决定一劳永逸地解决这件事，并通过参加大卫所知道的泳池派对来测试他们新关系的极限。
性爱派对由一位名叫温特的富有女士主办，将为他们提供结识新朋友并释放他们最深的欲望的绝佳机会。

他们的关系能熬过温特夫人特殊的放荡之夜吗？
跟随他们的故事并找出……
